steps.note: Start the eRFX project creation flow.

Publish the two-stage event.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Open the invited vendor's separate supplier-portal session.

Check that the first named clause is visible to the vendor.

Submit the vendor's Technical-stage response after accepting both clauses.
